cells.docstring: Set aspects of the visual theme for all seaborn and matplotlib plots.

font_scale.description: Scaling factor to scale font size relative to context.

cells.docstring: Set the aesthetic style of the plots.

style.description: Aesthetic style name for matplotlib rcParams.

cells.docstring: Set the plotting context parameters.

context.description: Context target determining label and line scales.

cells.docstring: Set the matplotlib color cycle using a seaborn palette.

n_colors.description: Number of distinct colors in the discrete cycle.

cells.docstring: Load an example dataset from the online seaborn repository as a pandas DataFrame.

name.description: Name of the sample dataset to load.

data.description: Loaded tabular sample DataFrame ready for seaborn plotting.

effects.description: Loaded dataset must be a 2D tabular structure.

cells.docstring: Return a list of colors defining a color palette.

palette_list.description: List of RGB tuples defining the palette.

cells.docstring: Plot univariate distributions using histogram bins and optional KDE smoothing curve.

data.description: Input tabular dataset containing variable to plot.

x.description: Column key in data for horizontal axis coordinate.

bins.description: Number of equal-width bins for histogram aggregation.

kde.description: Whether to overlay a kernel density estimate curve.

ax.description: Target matplotlib Axes instance to draw onto.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

effects.description: Axes must contain rendered patches or lines representing histogram.

cells.docstring: Plot bivariate distribution of two numeric variables using 2D histogram bins.

cbar.description: Whether to render a colorbar indicating 2D bin counts.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Plot partitioned histogram distributions grouped by categorical hue with stack or dodge mode.

hue.description: Categorical column to map onto color hue.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Compute and plot a univariate kernel density estimate curve.

bw_adjust.description: Bandwidth adjustment factor modifying kernel smoothing degree.

fill.description: Whether to fill area beneath the KDE curve.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Compute and plot a 2D contour kernel density estimate.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.kdeplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, fill={fill}, thresh={thresh}, ax={ax})

fill.description: Whether to color fill contour regions.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Plot empirical cumulative distribution functions (ECDF).

hue.description: Optional grouping variable for color hue.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Plot marginal distributions by drawing ticks along an axis.

height.description: Proportion of axis spanned by each rug tick.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Figure-level interface for drawing distribution plots onto a FacetGrid.

col.description: Categorical column defining subplots across grid columns.

hue.description: Grouping variable mapped to color hue.

grid_out.description: Output multi-plot FacetGrid object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Show point estimates and confidence intervals as rectangular bars.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.barplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, estimator={estimator}, errorbar={errorbar}, ax={ax})

y.description: Numeric variable for y axis aggregation.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Categorical bar plot partitioned by secondary categorical variable hue.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.barplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, hue={hue}, palette={palette}, ax={ax})

hue.description: Secondary grouping variable mapped to bar color.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Show the counts of observations in each categorical bin using bars.

hue.description: Optional grouping variable for color hue.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Draw a box plot to show distributions with respect to categories.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.boxplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, notch={notch}, palette={palette}, ax={ax})

x.description: Categorical grouping variable on x axis.

y.description: Continuous response variable on y axis.

notch.description: Whether to notch the boxes to represent confidence interval around median.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Box plot grouped by primary x-category and secondary hue factor with dodging.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.boxplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, hue={hue}, dodge={dodge}, ax={ax})

dodge.description: Whether elements should be shifted along the categorical axis.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Draw a combination of boxplot and kernel density estimate across categorical levels.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.violinplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, split={split}, inner={inner}, ax={ax})

split.description: Whether to draw half of the violin for each hue level.

inner.description: Representation of data points in the violin interior.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Violin plot with split halves comparing two levels of a binary hue variable.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.violinplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, hue={hue}, split=True, inner={inner}, ax={ax})

hue.description: Binary categorical variable mapped to split halves.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Draw an enhanced box plot (letter-value plot) for larger datasets.

k_depth.description: Strategy for calculating depth of letter values.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Draw a categorical scatterplot with jitter to avoid overplotting.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.stripplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, jitter={jitter}, alpha={alpha}, ax={ax})

jitter.description: Whether to displace points with uniform jitter.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Draw a categorical scatterplot with non-overlapping points.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.swarmplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, size={size}, palette={palette}, ax={ax})

size.description: Radius of the markers in points.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Show point estimates and confidence intervals using scatter plot glyphs and connecting lines.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.pointplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, hue={hue}, linestyles={linestyles}, ax={ax})

linestyles.description: Line style connecting points across categories.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Figure-level interface for drawing categorical plots onto a FacetGrid.

col.description: Column variable for faceting across subplots.

grid_out.description: Output multi-plot FacetGrid object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Draw a relational scatter plot with bivariate coordinates.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Multidimensional relational scatterplot with hue and marker size semantics.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.scatterplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, hue={hue}, size={size}, sizes={sizes}, palette={palette}, ax={ax})

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Draw a line plot with statistical aggregation and error bands.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Draw line plots with groupings mapped to hue and dash styles.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.lineplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, hue={hue}, style={style}, markers={markers}, ax={ax})

style.description: Variable mapped to line dash style.

markers.description: Whether to draw glyph markers at observation points.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.code_template: {grid_out} = sns.relplot(data={data}, x={x}, y={y}, col={col}, hue={hue}, kind={kind})

grid_out.description: Output multi-plot FacetGrid object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Plot rectangular data as a color-encoded matrix heatmap with numeric annotations.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.heatmap(data={data}, annot={annot}, fmt={fmt}, cmap={cmap}, cbar={cbar}, ax={ax})

annot.description: If True, write the data value in each cell.

fmt.description: String formatting code when annot is True.

cbar.description: Whether to draw a colormap colorbar.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

cells.docstring: Matrix heatmap masking triangular or invalid cells with custom colormap.
cells.code_template: {ax_out} = sns.heatmap(data={data}, mask={mask}, cmap={cmap}, square={square}, linewidths={linewidths}, ax={ax})

mask.description: Boolean mask array indicating which cells to exclude from drawing.

square.description: Whether to force aspect ratio of each cell to 1:1 square.

linewidths.description: Width of lines dividing each cell.

ax_out.description: Output plotting Axes object, usable by matplotlib-style finishing functions (savefig, legend, tight_layout, annotate) afterward.

hue.description: Variable that defines subsets mapped to different color levels.

cells.docstring: Plot data and a linear regression model fit with confidence interval.
